item.title: System 1 Intelligence for EduVis
item.description: Explore how System 1 decision models like TypeSafe AI’s Jev and the open-source NanoJev can complement generative LLMs in educational software. Using EduVis as a case study, this post examines token-free decision inference, structured probability outputs, pedagogical routing, and the role of deterministic validation in hybrid AI architectures.
